results.name: Rice
results.description:
Rice
***밥***
Food cooked by putting grains such as rice and barley in a pot and pouring water into it. It is the most basic Korean food. There are many recipes for cooking grains, but among them, rice is the most common food. There is a custom that considers rice more important than side dishes, which continues to be a dietary custom. Explanation Source : Encyclopedia of Korean Culture

results.name: Korean_Cabbage
results.description:
Korean_Cabbage
***배추***
The country of origin is China and is thought to have been cultivated in Korea for a long time. Cabbage is the main ingredient of kimchi, and it can be said to be one of the four major vegetables in Korea along with radish, red pepper, and garlic. Explanation Source : Encyclopedia of Korean Culture

results.name: Momo (food)
results.description:
Momo are a type of Tibetan and Nepalese dumpling dish popular in these regions. Momo is found in the cuisines of Nepal and Tibet. It is similar to baozi, jiaozi and mantou in Chinese cuisine, buuz in Mongolian cuisine, gyoza in Japanese cuisine, mandu in Korean cuisine and manti in Afghan cuisines.

results.name: Bamboo_Basket

Bamboo_Basket
***소쿠리***
A basket made of thinly cut bamboo. Bamboo, the material of this basket, was developed around the southern part of Korea because it was produced in the southern part of Korea. The basket's use is also used to dry food, wash grains and vegetables in water, and then drain them. Explanation Source : Encyclopedia of Korean Culture
